metricMeanings.nativeCoverageVenues: Complete native inventory rows, including research candidates/components; not qualified sites or nationwide field coverage.
metricMeanings.directoryObservations: Publisher observations; not branches or physical shops.
metricMeanings.nativeAcceptedHostMemberships: Native source-record-to-host assertions; publication eligibility is separate.
metricMeanings.nativeCandidateOnlySourceRecords: Source records with candidate hosts and no accepted host.
metricMeanings.nativeSourceLinkRowsWithoutHostReference: Native source rows with neither accepted nor candidate host references; not evidence that a branch should belong to a venue.
metricMeanings.publishedListingItems: Actual displayed items; not a census of independent physical shops.
metricMeanings.acceptedSourceLinksNeedingPublicationGat: Accepted native links with no exact public trace or reviewed disposition; not automatically eligible or missing shops.
metricMeanings.requiredAdmittedMembershipsUnaccountedFo: New admitted source identities absent from public evidence and without a justified explicit hold; release blocking.

limits: Recorded source availability is not a fresh HTTP check unless supplied as such.
Absence is not closure or evidence of no tenants.
A source membership, accepted native host link and physical shop are different grains.
Detailed identities, venue queues and evidence remain private.
Native inventory audit date is asOf. Later CI hash checks bind this reviewed projection; they do not refresh native sources or conduct a nightly field census.
